text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса is supposed to be the
strongest in
the world. However, she
faces a shocking defeat
at the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Doubting her abilities, she begins to
worry she
won't be able to spread her
wings for the world
and advance
confidently to the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, I decide that El Condor
Pasa needs
some time to get her
thoughts in order.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suggest running in the Mainichi Okan
before
taking on the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
